'''Prison Transfer and Processing''' was an installation located along the eastern wall of the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], in which newly arriving prisoners would be processed into [[Belsavis prison]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis|riot]] around [[3641 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]], the central power plant failed, trapping [[Zale Barrows]] and his girlfriend [[Kayla Perlis]] in the installation's hangar. Barrows left to restore power, but Perlis was caught and killed by the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Skadge]].
